author: mvmary9
body:
mvmary9
I was banned for "abusing support rooms".
I believe I should be unbanned because even though I was asked multiple times to leave the support room, I was part of the issue and nobody was hearing me out when I tried to explain to them when I was in there. Also the final time I went into support room #1, I meant to go into support #2 but I was banned almost instantly.

title: mvmary9 teamspeak ban appeal

replies.author: Newcleus
replies.body:
Mary,

I don't really think that abuse of support room constitutes nearly a ban of 7 days, so I have significantly shortened the length of your ban. You did break a rule, as you are to listen a staff member's instructions at all times, so your ban does remain valid.

Thank you.

replies.body:
Hello Mary,

I do agree with Michael's decision to shorter your ban time on Teamspeak. I would also like to apologize for the situation that occurred earlier in the support channel, I know that you did not mean to cause trouble.

Thank you for your appeal.

Best regards,
FrostedCupcakez
